strings.zh: 好玩吗？{NEWLINE}这里的老虎机{CLEAR}可都是最新型的！{SCROLL}在关东你休想找到{NEWLINE}如此前卫的游戏机专柜！

strings.zh: 要玩好老虎机,{NEWLINE}你就得摸清上面滚筒。{SCROLL}先预读滚筒的的动向,{NEWLINE}拉的时候要稍稍提前一点,{CLEAR}这样就比较容易中。{SCROLL}「７」比较好认,{NEWLINE}你得盯紧点。
strings.en: To be good at slots, you have{NEWLINE}to get a feel for the reels.{SCROLL}Read where the reels are{NEWLINE}going and press a little early.{CLEAR}That way it’s easier to hit.{SCROLL}The ‘7’ is easy to spot,{NEWLINE}so keep your eyes on it.

strings.zh: 如果凑齐了「皮卡丘」「玛力露」{NEWLINE}「柑果」「重试」,{SCROLL}你就要仔细观察{NEWLINE}屏幕内的图图犬。{SCROLL}图图犬若是高兴,{NEWLINE}则出现「７」或是「精灵球」时,{CLEAR}你能获得的代币{CLEAR}将大幅度增加！{SCROLL}所以当滚筒凑齐后,{NEWLINE}你要注意一下图图犬的表情。
strings.en: If you line up Pikachu,{NEWLINE}Marill, Apricorn or Replay,{SCROLL}watch the Smeargle on{NEWLINE}the screen closely.{SCROLL}If Smeargle is happy, then when{NEWLINE}a ‘7’ or a Poké Ball comes up,{CLEAR}the coins you win will go way up!{SCROLL}So once the reels line up, keep{NEWLINE}an eye on Smeargle’s expression.
strings.notes: Slot symbols: 柑果 → Apricorn (as 柑果大叔 → Uncle Apricorn), 重试 → Replay, 图图犬 = Smeargle.

strings.zh: 老虎机游戏中{NEWLINE}有三种{CLEAR}表示图图犬心情的模式。{SCROLL}第一个是「普通模式」。{SCROLL}游戏必定是从{NEWLINE}普通模式开始进行的。{SCROLL}第二个是「萎靡模式」{SCROLL}当你看到图图犬周围{NEWLINE}都变成蓝色时,{CLEAR}就说明进入了萎靡模式。{SCROLL}该模式下不太容易中{NEWLINE}「７」或者「精灵球」,{SCROLL}但是更容易中{NEWLINE}「皮卡丘」「柑果」{CLEAR}「玛力露」「重试」。{SCROLL}第三个是「兴奋模式」{SCROLL}当你看到图图犬周围{NEWLINE}都变成红色时,{CLEAR}就说明进入了兴奋模式。{SCROLL}该模式下能更容易中{NEWLINE}「７」或者「精灵球」,{CLEAR}是你发财的好机会！！{SCROLL}当你熟练掌握这三种模式后,{NEWLINE}你会发现胜利来得是如此简单,{CLEAR}去好好观察吧。
strings.en: The slot game has three modes{NEWLINE}that show Smeargle’s mood.{SCROLL}The first is Normal Mode.{SCROLL}The game always starts in Normal Mode.{SCROLL}The second is Gloomy Mode.{SCROLL}When you see the area around Smeargle{NEWLINE}turn blue, you’ve entered Gloomy Mode.{SCROLL}In this mode, it’s harder{NEWLINE}to hit a ‘7’ or a Poké Ball,{SCROLL}but easier to hit Pikachu,{NEWLINE}Apricorn, Marill or Replay.{SCROLL}The third is Excited Mode.{SCROLL}When you see the area around Smeargle{NEWLINE}turn red, you’ve entered Excited Mode.{SCROLL}In this mode, it’s easier to hit{NEWLINE}a ‘7’ or a Poké Ball. It’s your{CLEAR}big chance to strike it rich!!{SCROLL}Once you’ve mastered these{NEWLINE}three modes, you’ll find winning{CLEAR}is a breeze. Go watch closely.

strings.zh: 当图图犬出现{NEWLINE}愤怒表情时,{CLEAR}说明它此时心情很糟糕。{SCROLL}如果你错失了{NEWLINE}「７」或者「精灵球」,{SCROLL}它就会怒不可赦,{NEWLINE}没准会改变{CLEAR}现在的模式！{SCROLL}愤怒表情越多,{NEWLINE}越容易动怒。{SCROLL}模式转换之后,{NEWLINE}图图犬便发泄了自己的情绪,{CLEAR}会出现许许多多的笑脸,{SCROLL}一定时间内{NEWLINE}不会再次改变模式。{SCROLL}但如果你多次不中,{NEWLINE}它的情绪又会逐步下降。
strings.en: When Smeargle makes an angry{NEWLINE}face, it’s in a really bad mood.{SCROLL}If you miss a ‘7’ or a Poké Ball,{SCROLL}it’ll get furious and might{NEWLINE}even change the current mode!{SCROLL}The more angry faces,{NEWLINE}the quicker it gets mad.{SCROLL}Once the mode changes, Smeargle{NEWLINE}has let off steam, and lots{CLEAR}of smiling faces will appear.{SCROLL}The mode won’t change again for a while.{SCROLL}But if you keep missing, its{NEWLINE}mood will slowly drop again.

strings.zh: 当中了「７」或者「精灵球」后,{NEWLINE}你就可以玩上奖励游戏。{SCROLL}在奖励游戏下,{NEWLINE}中奖的几率会增加,{CLEAR}也是你发财的好机会。{SCROLL}另外,当奖励游戏结束后{NEWLINE}必定会进入兴奋模式,{SCROLL}这将延续你中大奖的好运！{SCROLL}在奖励游戏中中得越多,{SCROLL}兴奋模式的持续时间也会延长。
strings.en: When you hit a ‘7’ or a Poké Ball,{NEWLINE}you get to play the bonus game.{SCROLL}In the bonus game, your odds{NEWLINE}of winning go up. It’s another{CLEAR}great chance to strike it rich.{SCROLL}Also, once the bonus game ends,{NEWLINE}you’ll always enter Excited Mode.{SCROLL}That keeps your lucky streak going!{SCROLL}The more you win in the bonus game,{SCROLL}the longer Excited Mode will last.
